recommendedBy: session agent, after a three-way review of the component specifications

items.why: The only open high: keyboard resize is unbounded, and the keyboard is the accessible path.
The specification itself sends a consumer to the wrong stylesheet, which is CUI-006's failure with a documented cause.
A silent unstyled render is a bad failure mode for a design system, and one app shipped that way unnoticed.
A documented accessibility escalation that does nothing, and a test that cannot catch it.
Reduced motion silently breaks any consumer chaining messages off onDone.
An alert that announces nothing, newly visible now the Form pattern can error at all.
A section the gate has never once photographed.
